description: Various minor internal and external alterations comprising of; the removal of window sash boxes and weights, changes to the window mullion arrangement, the removal of two sash windows, the installation of secondary glazing, the making of builders works holes, the removal of existing ceiling and installation of new ceiling, the installation of new light fittings, the removal of existing chamber hatch and installation of extract vent and integrated bench, the installation of a new drainage gully, the undertaking of below ground drainage works including the installation of access chamber and provision of new conditions, the removal of existing risers and installation of new risers, the removal of existing floor boxes and installation of new floor boxes, removal of electrical trunking, the external replacement of rainwater goods and hoppers, the removal of bricks and installation of airbricks, cupboard refurbishment and provision of new internal door, the removal of plasterboard wall linings and FSU casings and reinstatement of plasterboard wall linings and skirting's, the installation of new FCU casings, minor demolition works, replacement roof covering, removal of ductwork, roof plant rearrangement, the installation of a new external door to plant area, minor layout alterations and other associated works.
